description: This file defines the 'ChannelMember' data model and related structures and functions for managing channel membership, notification preferences, and validation within the Mattermost project.

classes.name: ChannelUnread
classes.description: Represents unread message counts and notification properties for a channel.

classes.name: ChannelUnreadAt
classes.description: Tracks the last viewed timestamp and unread counts for a user in a channel.

classes.name: ChannelMember
classes.description: Models a user's membership in a channel, including roles, notification preferences, and timestamps.

classes.name: ChannelMemberWithTeamData
classes.description: Extends ChannelMember with additional team display information.

classes.name: ChannelMemberForExport
classes.description: Represents a channel member with additional export-related fields.

classes.name: ChannelMemberCursor
classes.description: Pagination cursor for channel member queries.

classes.name: ChannelMemberIdentifier
classes.description: Unique identifier for a channel member, combining channel and user IDs.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the channel member's data for auditing purposes.

methods.name: SanitizeForCurrentUser
methods.description: Sanitizes sensitive timestamp fields if the member is not the current user.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the channel member data, including IDs and notification properties.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Updates the last update timestamp before saving.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates the last update timestamp before updating.

methods.name: GetRoles
methods.description: Returns the roles assigned to the channel member as a slice of strings.

methods.name: SetChannelMuted
methods.description: Sets the mute status for the channel based on notification properties.

methods.name: IsChannelMuted
methods.description: Checks if the channel is muted for the member.
